## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth ≤4/11 and Financials (1W: -4.04%) plus Industrials (1W: -3.65%) are both negative; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Tech in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: CVX (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +4.17% | 1M: +19.68%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +3.67% | 1M: +16.37%) ABOVE TREND. Technology shows pockets of strength: ORCL (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) ABOVE TREND and AVGO (1W: +7.57% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY. Materials on spot rallies: DOW (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +8.41%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials weak: JPM (1W: -3.96% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.40% | 1M: -18.74%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -8.84% | 1M: -11.43%) BELOW TREND. Industrials lag: UPS (1W: -8.78% | 1M: -13.33%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -12.51%) BELOW TREND. Materials also showing weakness in many names despite DOW’s outperformance.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AVGO (1W: +7.57% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +8.41%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +5.27% | 1M: -4.50%) RECOVERY, SBUX (1W: +4.42% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Tech).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TFC (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -15.83%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -17.98%) BELOW TREND, SHW (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -10.30%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -7.73% | 1M: -7.25%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -7.85% | 1M: -17.72%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AVGO (1W: +7.57% | 1M: -0.69%) RECOVERY, ORCL (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +8.41%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present among large caps (NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) — treat moves as tactical and watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak with pockets of strength: ORCL (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) ABOVE TREND vs AAPL (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -5.03%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -3.30%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: +1.64% | 1M: -2.10%) RECOVERY. Sector showing internal rotation rather than broad leadership.

8. Financials Outlook?
Broadly weak: JPM (1W: -3.96% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -4.91%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.62% | 1M: -5.85%) BELOW TREND; multiple banks in bottom decile (TFC, COF, WFC). Sector at risk amid the RISK-OFF backdrop.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed defensive flossing: PFE (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +2.36%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -1.54% | 1M: +4.27%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND. Overall healthcare breadth soft but with selective positive catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select ORCL exposure for tactical strength; reduce exposure to Financials and cyclical Industrials showing broad downside. Style: Defensive / mixed — be selective as leadership is narrow and large-cap divergences are material.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +4.17% | 1M: +19.68%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TFC (1W: -7.05% | 1M: -15.83%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.40% | 1M: -18.74%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -8.84% | 1M: -11.43%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +2.01% | 1M: +9.18%) — concentrated leadership. BEARISH: Financials (1W: -4.04% | 1M: -9.56%) and Industrials (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -3.03%) — monitor for further downside.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor weekly closes vs 1M trends for large caps rather than single-price calls: watch NVDA (1W: +1.64% | 1M: -2.10%) RECOVERY for fail/pass of the 1M downtrend, AAPL (1W: -0.65% | 1M: -5.03%) BELOW TREND for follow-through below recent monthly lows, JPM (1W: -3.96% | 1M: -10.74%) BELOW TREND for any additional weekly breakdown.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (+85): ORCL (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/2027 outlook confirms price strength. PFE (+70): PFE (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND — China approval confirmed by positive price action. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: -0.37% | 1M: -4.13%) BELOW TREND — sentiment is bullish but price is diverging, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
SYK (-45): SYK (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -2.89%) BELOW TREND — negative news confirmed by sharp price weakness. (Other high-signal bearish names in news exist but are outside the provided price feed for confirmation.)

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Defensive tilt. CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +6.06%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.17% | 1M: +19.68%) and ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.06% | 1M: +4.17%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: large-cap divergences (NVDA RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY, AMZN CORRECTION) and narrow leadership mean tactical moves only and watch sentiment/price confirmation.
